pages.text: Two trees grow here. Glowwood is the cyan building wood. Glowroot is the signature self-lit species — its whole wood set glows faintly. Both have full sets: planks, stairs, slabs, fences, doors, signs, boats, and more — and both behave as normal wood (crafting tables, chests, fuel).

Plant a sapling to grow a tree. Glowroot grows a spreading 2x2 tree when four saplings are planted together — and a town-sized giant generates in the $(l:glowroot_forest)Glowroot Forest$(/l). Strip logs with an axe for the smooth variant.
